run_gtest_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_full: test that gtest prints help message when the --help flag is specified
test_help_flag_short: test that gtest prints help message when the -h short flag is specified
test_help_flag_question: test that gtest prints help message when the -? or /? flag is specified
test_non_help_flag: test that gtest runs tests normally when no help flag is specified
